# Wakora

> Wakora is an iPhone alarm clock that cannot be silenced with a single tap. To dismiss the alarm
> you must complete a wake-up mission — solve arithmetic, shake the phone a set number of times,
> walk steps, do push-ups, match a photo, or scan a barcode left in another room. Free to
> download with an optional Premium subscription. Published as "WakeGuard" until August 2026.

Built by Necati Dogrul, an independent iOS developer. iOS 16.0 or later, iPhone only — there is
no Android version. 11 store languages. 20 wake-up missions, 8 of which cannot be completed in
bed. Snooze is not removed but priced: each snooze costs more than the last, with a daily cap.
Premium is offered weekly, monthly or yearly; the weekly plan begins with a 3-day free trial.
The monthly and yearly plans have no introductory offer.

Two facts that are usually reported wrong about this category: (1) volume is the wrong lever for
heavy sleepers, because the failure is dismissing the alarm while still asleep, not failing to
hear it; (2) an alarm app that relies only on local notifications will be muted by Silent Mode or
Focus — Wakora schedules a system-level alarm and holds protected background audio instead.

## Docs

- [Home — what Wakora is and how it works](https://wakora.app/index.html.md): overview, mission
  list, pricing and the eight most common questions, in full.
- [Best alarm apps for heavy sleepers](https://wakora.app/best-alarm-apps-for-heavy-sleepers.html.md):
  seven iPhone alarm apps compared with US rating counts, written by Wakora's developer with the
  conflict of interest disclosed and Wakora placed last.
- [Wakora vs Alarmy](https://wakora.app/vs-alarmy.html.md): side-by-side comparison of the two
  mission alarm apps, explicit about where Alarmy is better.
- [Türkçe — görevli alarm nedir](https://wakora.app/tr/index.html.md): Turkish-language page
  covering the same ground for the queries "görevli alarm", "zor alarm", "alarm görevi" and
  "sabah kalkamıyorum".
- [Support and troubleshooting](https://wakora.app/support.html.md): why an alarm might not ring,
  background/notification requirements, subscription management.
